When it's approved you'll get the prepaid label, the Shop···· reference to write on the box, and the drop-off steps. I'll post them here too.

One thing I'm curious about while we wait: the NerdQaxe++ ran fine from July to now. Was it running in the same spot as the three Gammas, same outlet and power strip, or on its own circuit?

Useful, thanks. Cool-running and a clean strip points away from heat or dirty power, which backs up the board fault Hal wrote up rather than anything on your end. I've noted it with the return.

One last one, if you don't mind: when it died, did it stop mid-hash while you were away, or did it go after a restart or a power blip?

Im not sure, I was out of town on a job, on the pool I was on I noticed it just dropped the th from that unit, it was around mid day. Asked the wife if we had any power outages like the oven clock reset and she said no.

That's a clean picture: dropped off the pool mid-day with no outage, so it failed on its own rather than from anything you did. I've added that to the file with the return.

Nothing more needed from you. Keep it unplugged and watch for the approval, and I'll post the label and the Shop···· reference here as soon as it lands.
